params.body:
## What

On the dealer website widget, the price slider's bars could show a car the list did not: a selected
price range with two bars above it but one car underneath.

The bars and the list were two computations. The histogram was drawn once, at page load, in PHP over
a snapshot of the stock; the list is filtered live, in SQL. So the bars did not move when the visitor
narrowed the filters, and they binned the shown price with the PHP form of the rule while the filter
selected with the SQL form. One price, computed in two places.

## Change

The bars are now one computation with the list:

- Each slider's bars are a facet: the spread of the stock that passes every OTHER filter, binned into
  bounds taken from the whole stock, so the handles still reach every car (R S2-5.29). A slider never
  bins its own range, as R S1-5.15 already does for the Stocklist search.
- The price bars read the shown price in SQL (`PublicWebsitePrice::sql`), the very expression the
  filter uses, so a bar stands exactly where the list holds a car.
- They are recomputed on every filter change and shipped with the AJAX response; the frontend redraws
  only the bar heights, leaving the bounds fixed so the handles do not jump.

`VehicleRepository::forWebsiteQuery` gains two optional parameters (skip the user filters for the
bounds; leave one filter out for its own facet), and `websiteMetricValues` reads the values in SQL.

Because the histogram now runs `forWebsiteQuery` several times per page, a garage whose shared stock
is limited to a range is geocoded once per page build (`forgetWebsiteCentre`) rather than once per
query, so a page view asks Google no more often than before.

Fixes bevinding de-prijsbalkjes-liepen-niet-met-de-lijst. R S2-5.13 updated.

## Tests

- `WebsitePriceSliderTest`: a bar stands exactly where the list has a car (own stock plus a
  colleague's margin vehicle), and the price bars follow a make filter. The four earlier cases
  (bounds reach the cheapest and dearest, the margin and VAT prices, "op aanvraag" drops out) still
  hold.
- PHPStan clean; full suite green on a fresh database.
params.title: Website price slider: bars follow the filters and match the list
